# 2021 Candidates

## Two candidates nominated for Constable of St. Clement by-election

Marcus Troy and Simon Brée were nominated for the role of Constable of St. Clement at the nomination meeting on 30 June, at St. Clement’s Parish Hall.

Election day took place on Wednesday 28 July. Any St. Clement resident aged 16 or over was eligible to place their vote at St. Clement’s Parish Hall. The successful candidate was officially sworn into office on Friday 30 July and took up the role until Jersey’s next General Election on 22 June 2022.

The full list of proposers and seconders are listed below:

**Marcus Troy:**

- Chris Le Cornu (proposer)
- Anne Dupre

- Geoff Pirouet
